_note: The premium a capped life policy may not exceed in any year for its sums to be excluded (D-205). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 Schedule II Table Sl. 2 col. C (a): a unit linked policy issued on or after 1-2-2021, "aggregate of premium for all such policies (in any of the tax years during the term of all of such policies) is ≤ ₹ 2,50,000"; any other policy issued on or after 1-4-2023, ≤ ₹ 5,00,000 (p.499); (b) the limits "shall not apply to any sum received under a life Insurance policy issued on or after the 1st April, 2025, by the international Financial Services Centre Insurance Office". Not on death (col. C (a)). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.10(10D) fourth and sixth provisos (FA 2021 s.6(c); FA 2023 s.5(d)), the eighth as FA 2025 s.6(e) substituted it — not on death, nor for any policy an IFSC insurance office issued, with no issue date. Several capped policies of one class follow the Board's guidelines, CBDT Circulars No. 2/2022 (ULIPs, 19-1-2022) and No. 15/2023 (other policies, 16-8-2023), in force for TY 2026-27 by S2 s.536(2)(j): only this year's claims and the policies claimed exempt earlier count, year by year over their premium years, and a claim that breaches is not excluded (LifePolicySums; D-207); premium is without GST (No. 15/2023 para 5). Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-life-policies.md.
